kv.memory.beads-backend-use-server: Always use backend=server for beads. A local dolt sql-server runs on 127.0.0.1:3308. Set via: bd config set backend server. The embedded backend has single-writer lock issues that block parallel bd commands.
kv.memory.cel-function-library-is-the-pr: CEL function library is one extension point (predicates). Felt language is the other (pure computation → WASM GC). Perturber handles bounded mutations. Three tiers: CEL (read-only queries), perturber (bounded state changes), Felt (complex algorithms). Rust WASM for power users.
kv.memory.cel-predicate-boundary-cel-fun: CEL predicate boundary: CEL functions are pure state queries only (O(board_size), guaranteed termination). Hypotheticals (move simulation, checkmate) belong in Tier 2 WASM extensions. Decision recorded as baize-7a2.
kv.memory.commit-reveal-for-randomness-s: Commit-reveal for randomness ships in earliest releases. Purpose: force all client implementations to have the protocol space open for serverless crypto, even before full mental poker. This is a deliberate architectural forcing function, not just a feature.
kv.memory.dictionary-resource-system-dec: Dictionary/resource system decided: game definitions reference external resources by name, engine loads them, host imports expose typed accessors (word_valid, etc). baize-fkmb. Immediate need: Scrabble. Pattern extends to any large external data.
kv.memory.dynamic-visibility-decided-yes: Dynamic visibility decided: YES, implement it. Required for Bridge (dummy hand exposure), Stratego (combat reveals), Mahjong (meld exposure). baize-8e3j filed as P2.
kv.memory.fog-of-war-decided-pre-allocat: Fog of war decided: per-cell per-player visibility (unexplored/visible/fogged). Uses sparse grid (baize-ew83) — no pre-allocation needed. Server holds full map, reveals on exploration. Vision range from unit positions. Extends dynamic visibility (baize-8e3j) to cell level. baize-21n8.
kv.memory.game-definitions-should-declar: Game definitions should declare named CEL expressions and perturber sequences in a library section, not rely on hardcoded engine strings. Tic-tac-toe's three_in_line is the canonical example: currently hardcoded in legacy string dispatch, should instead be a named CEL expression in the game definition. Same pattern as Rubik's Cube named moves. baize-bu6 covers this.
kv.memory.implementation-start-json-sche: Project status (2026-06-12): 286/302 issues closed. Core engine complete in Rust+Python. 57 game definitions. Felt compiler built (lexer/parser/checker/codegen, 127 tests, 35 builtins wired as host imports). Poker playable. Paranoid hardening complete. Server with WebSocket, WASM sandboxing, rate limiting. TypeScript client has types, 5 Web Components, 86 tests. Sparse/dense grid storage, cell stacking, partnerships, dynamic visibility, fog of war all implemented.
kv.memory.json-schema-oneof-pitfall-neve: JSON Schema oneOf pitfall: never combine {const: 'value'} with {type: 'string'} in a oneOf — the const value matches both branches, causing validation failure. Use a single {type: 'string'} with description instead. Same applies to enum values. Fixed in game-definition.schema.json (owner, direction) and component-registry.schema.json (shape, stroke).
kv.memory.mental-poker-crypto-approach-u: Mental poker crypto approach: use num-bigint + num-integer crates with RFC 3526 2048-bit MODP group for SRA commutative encryption. NOT constant-time (game context, not state secrets). Protocol layer is backend-agnostic — swap to WASI-Crypto when it stabilizes (baize-jspg). Keypair: random e coprime to p-1, d = e^-1 mod (p-1). Encrypt: m^e mod p. Decrypt: c^d mod p.
kv.memory.multi-cell-spans-implemented-a: Multi-cell spans implemented as first-class engine feature. Same ComponentId stored in every occupied cell. ComponentData.span_cells tracks occupied cells. PlaceShip action validates bounds+overlap, Fire action checks opponent ocean grid, places hit/miss pegs on attacker target, tracks hit_count for sunk detection. Both Rust and Python engines.
kv.memory.out-of-band-and-free-form-play: Out-of-band and free-form player communication (chat, voice, emoji reactions) are explicitly out of scope. Baize is a game rules engine, not a social platform. Player communication happens in external tools (Discord, etc.). Mark noted 'we are not competing with discord here.'
kv.memory.partnerships-decided-array-of-: Partnerships decided: array of player arrays in game definition. Engine uses for win propagation and shared counters. Cross-partner actions are game-specific (rules/phases/Felt). baize-4htd.
kv.memory.reactive-turns-decided-option-: Reactive turns decided: Option B — action triggers with claim windows. Turn system unchanged. Triggers declared in game definition, engine pauses for mini-simultaneous collection after matching actions, server resolves by priority. baize-zt7c.
kv.memory.reference-game-playability-sta: Reference game playability status (2026-06-12): 21 games fully playable end-to-end with tests. 36 more have definitions that parse/validate with gameplay tests. 57 total game definitions. Texas Hold'em poker fully playable (betting, hand evaluation, showdown). Felt compiler built (127 tests). New: Infinite Go (sparse), Power Grid (graph economy), Fury of Dracula (hidden movement), Triangle Dominoes (hex tiles), Chickenfoot (dynamic graph).
kv.memory.simultaneous-moves-decided-opt: Simultaneous moves: decided Option B — compose from phase simultaneous:true + visibility model + server submission gate. No new turn_order type. Phase collects private actions, server waits for all, then reveals. Covers RPS, Diplomacy, etc.
kv.memory.sparse-grid-decided-hashmap-i3: Grid storage decided: BOTH dense and sparse behind one interface. Dense (Vec) when dimensions given — backward compat, cache-friendly. Sparse (HashMap<(i32,i32)>) when dimensions omitted or large (>1000). Auto-promote. Signed coords for sparse. Works for grid + hex_grid. baize-ew83.
kv.memory.stacking-decided-vec-component: Stacking decided: Vec<ComponentId> per cell with stacking_limit (default 1 = backward compat). cell_at returns cell_top. LIFO stack semantics. baize-5hux.
kv.memory.time-controls-schema-declares-: Time controls: schema declares time_control type + timeout_result (loss/draw/none = game rule). Server overrides seconds/increment at room creation. Server owns clock state and enforcement. Client displays server-provided clock.
kv.memory.wargame-primitives-decided-cel: Wargame primitives decided: cell properties for terrain data (already works), Felt extensions for combat/ZOC/pathfinding. No new schema types. Blocked on Felt stdlib. baize-6fm9.
kv.memory.wasm-has-no-standard-library-n: WASM has no standard library. No strings, no data structures, no allocator. Every language compiles its own. Component Model + WIT (WASI 0.2/0.3) adds shared type contracts between modules but not algorithm implementations. WASM GC proposal adds struct/array types but isn't in wasmtime yet. Felt must ship its own runtime (~5KB) in every .wasm binary until this changes.
